verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an API endpoint that starts an automation for a specific contact, which confirms EmailOctopus has its own automation feature. Nothing in the pack shows whether those automations can be multi-step, and send-time scheduling is a different capability, not lifecycle automation. Missing for 10: documented multi-step sequences (welcome/onboarding/winback), conditional branches, delay steps, exit rules, a visual builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build multi-step lifecycle automations — welcome series, onboarding, winback — with branches, delays, and exit rules

citations.quote: Start an automation for a specific contact.
